Court Grants Interim Bail to Swatantra Bhardwaj in CJP Protest Clash

A Delhi court granted interim bail for three weeks to Swatantra Bhardwaj, who was arrested for allegedly assaulting a protestor associated with the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP). The court's decision provides relief to Bhardwaj in the case related to the clash during a CJP protest. The specifics of the alleged assault and the circumstances of the protest were central to the legal proceedings.
